name: Idlirvirissong
prompt: Edit this Inuit supernatural spirit illustration while preserving clothing, two arms/two legs, three dogs, empty plate, sky-house doorway and vigorous dance pose. Change ONLY her facial expression and NOSE shape to the documented spirit Idlirvirissong: nose is distinctly exaggerated and TURNED UP AT BOTH SIDES, nostrils flaring visibly upward, broad tip curled up, recognizably uncanny at thumbnail scale. Face forms a deliberately grotesque theatrical grimace with twisted grin, one eyebrow high and other low, eyes fixed intensely on viewer; dangerous invitation rather than friendly happiness. No modern clown makeup, no giant body, no added horns/teeth/fangs, no injury or gore. Respectful original depiction of the specific hostile spirit; no text, aura or borrowed design. Basis idlirvirissong-c02,c09 upturned nose and c11 dancing/grimaces.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, face crop and dog crop. The figure reads as an ordinary middle-aged woman in a fur parka doing a kicking dance with a broad cheerful grin, beside three friendly, smiling huskies, in a timber doorway: an 'ordinary person with pet dogs' image that fails Uji Sangar #2/#7. The documented nose 'turned up on the sides' (idlirvirissong-c02/c09) is not legible: at native resolution it is a normal broad nose seen from below with visible nostrils, and at 200px nothing distinguishes it. The grimace reads as happy laughter rather than the uncanny, laughter-baiting clown grimace (c11), and the dogs look like friendly pets, not hungry dogs waiting to be fed (c05/c06). The sky house (c05/c09) reads only as clouds through a door. A realistic portrait of an ordinary Indigenous woman pulling a grotesque face also risks reading as an ethnic caricature, not as the spirit. Fully opaque hide clothing, an empty plate, two arms/two legs, and no text or gore are fine.

correction_notes: Redraw so the spirit is unmistakably not an ordinary woman: make the nose that is turned up and flared at both sides (idlirvirissong-c02/c09) a clear, readable trait at 200px. Make the dance an uncanny clown-like performance with grimaces meant to bait laughter (c02/c11), not a cheerful grin, and put her house plainly in the sky, with cloudbanks below or around the threshold (c05/c09). Show the many dogs as lean, hungry and watchful beside the empty plate qengmerping (c05/c06), not as smiling pets. Avoid a photographic ethnic portrait caricature. Keep fully opaque Arctic garments, no entrails, blood or gore, no aura, and no text.
